Charm a [[Melandru's Stalker]] and bring it to [[Master Ranger Nente]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
| profession = ranger
}}

===Objectives===
* Deliver a [[Melandru's Stalker]] to Nente.
* Return to [[Master Ranger Nente]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 200 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* {{skill icon|Hunter's Shot}}
* {{skill icon|Comfort Animal}}
* {{skill icon|Troll Unguent}}
* {{skill icon|Charm Animal}}

==Walkthrough==
[[File:Shalev the Hermit location.jpg|thumb|Way to Shalev's cave.]]
If you already have a Melandru's Stalker as a pet, you can immediately complete the quest by speaking to Nente again; he will not take your pet away. Otherwise, you will need to find a Stalker in [[Old Ascalon]] and tame it using {{skill icon|Charm Animal}}.

There is no quest marker to lead you to a Stalker, but some can be found nearby to the southwest of the entrance to [[The Breach]], past the statue of [[Balthazar]]. Alternatively, Stalkers can also be found around the cave that [[Shalev the Hermit]] lives in, which may be a shorter and safer option.

If you have already tamed a different type of pet, you will have to give up your pet to a [[pet tamer]] to complete the quest. [[Jarrel the Tamer]] can be found just outside [[Ascalon City]], but you may prefer to delay this quest until you have access to the [[Zaishen Menagerie]] to make your current pet easier to recover.

==Dialogue==
===Initial Dialogue===
;Master Ranger Nente
:''"Before the Searing many of the Melandru's Stalkers roamed the land. Now these great cats are nearing extinction, and if we are to know the true extend to which their population has been decimated I must keep an accurate count of them. If you can find and tame one of these beasts using the Charm Animal skill or if you already have one as a companion, bring it to me that I may update my current tally."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I will bring you a Stalker.
| decline = Perhaps another time.
| ask = Find one of '''Melandru's Stalkers''', tame the great cat using the Charm Animal skill if necessary, and bring it to me.
}}

===Reward Dialogue===
;Master Ranger Nente
:''"To tame one of Melandru's Stalker is no mean feat. Well done, my friend, well done. It is good to see that there are still some who strive to preserve the natural balance."''

==Notes==
* Master Ranger Nente will not recognize a Hero's or another player's pet to advance the quest.
{{anomaly|A Melandru's Stalker obtained from the [[Zaishen Menagerie]] will not suffice.}}
{{anomaly|This quest rewards the skill Charm Animal, but you need the skill in order to charm a Melandru's Stalker in the first place.
* You can buy the skill from [[Sir Bertran]] in [[Ascalon City]].}}
